name: premarket_range_breakout_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus
thesis: The pre-market session (09:00-09:08 IST) on NSE establishes an indicative price range for stocks through the call auction mechanism. This pre-market range, combined with SGX Nifty implied direction, defines an 'expected range' for the session open. When the stock opens outside this expected range (gap through pre-market levels), it signals surprise information and tends to trend in the gap direction. Conversely, if the stock opens within the pre-market range but breaks out of it within the first 30 minutes, this is a more reliable signal than a random breakout because the pre-market range represents the informed consensus. The edge exists because few systematic traders incorporate pre-market call auction data into their models — most treat 09:15 as the true open and ignore 09:00-09:08 data entirely.
mechanism: SGX NIFTY futures trade overnight and price in global market moves before Indian markets open. The opening gap reflects this information, but the initial price discovery is noisy. Within the first 5-15 minutes, the gap either extends (genuine revaluation) or fades (overnight overreaction), creating a tradeable directional signal.

conditions: close > PM_high (price has broken above pre-market high)
close < PM_low (price has broken below pre-market low)

exit.signal_exit: exit if price closes back within PM range for 3 bars

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22; pre-market ranges are wider in high-VIX regimes

weaknesses: Pre-market data is limited to call auction prices, which are indicative not traded — actual opening can differ significantly
Only ~20-30 NIFTY 100 stocks have meaningful pre-market volume/activity; most have sparse pre-market data
SGX Nifty closed in 2023; alternatives (GIFT Nifty) have different dynamics — need to adapt global cue source
prior_art: Pre-market analysis is discussed in US context with pre-market trading hours (4 AM - 9:30 AM ET). Indian pre-market call auction is unique due to the 8-minute window. NSE pre-market range as a trading level is discussed on TradingQ&A (Zerodha) forums but rarely formalized as a systematic strategy. Relatively novel in systematic form.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
